user.title: Power Probe
user.description: Pick the sensor that reports your whole-home power draw (Refoss, Emporia, Sense, Shelly EM, IoTaWatt and similar). Power Probe switches a device off and on and compares the readings. You can pick a different meter for any single run later.

data.timing_profile: How fast does the sensor update?
data.restore_state: Put the device back how it was

data_description.power_entity: A sensor in watts or kilowatts. A net meter on a house with solar gives noisier results.
data_description.timing_profile: Fast: changes every few seconds. Medium: every 10 to 30 seconds. Slow: about once a minute. If unsure, pick slow. Slower than that needs Custom, with a window of at least three updates. Custom lets you set the seconds yourself.
data_description.cycles: 1 runs off, on, off. More cycles average out other loads switching in the house, at the cost of time.
data_description.restore_state: After the final off reading, turn the device back on if it was on when the run started.

timing.title: Custom timing
timing.description: Settle time must be longer than the sensor's update interval, or the first readings of each step still show the previous state.

data_description.settle_time: Wait after each switch before reading.
data_description.sample_window: How long to keep reading after the settle time. The average of these readings is used.
data_description.sample_interval: Seconds between readings inside the window.

error.interval_longer_than_window: The time between readings cannot be longer than the reading window.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Power Probe is already set up. Change its settings from the integration's options.

init.title: Power Probe settings
init.description: These are the defaults. The sidebar panel and the start_measurement action can override them for a single run.

start_measurement.name: Start measurement
start_measurement.description: Switch a device off, read the whole-home meter, switch it on, read again, switch it off and read a final time. The difference is the device's draw. Returns the result when called with a response variable.

power_entity.description: Overrides the sensor chosen in the integration's options for this run.

settle_time.description: Seconds to wait after each switch before reading.

sample_interval.description: Seconds between readings inside the window.

cycles.description: Number of on/off cycles to average.
